units: <cite ref="Ketubot 104a:5">Keth. 104ᵃ</cite> <he>קַרְעֵיה … לקִרְעֵיה וכ׳</he> he rent his garment (at Rabbi’s death), and turned the rent inside (to hide it); a. e.—Pl. <he>קְרָעִין</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:5">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ</cite> top <he>וקרעון ואזל קלא דקרעין וכ׳</he> (not <he>דקרעון</he>) they rent their garments, and the lamentations accompanying the rending were heard as far &c., v. <cite ref="C00277"><he>גּוֹבְבָתָא</he></cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 12:3:5">Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ</cite> top <he>קלה לק׳</he> (read: <he>דק׳</he>); <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:11">Koh. R. to VII, 11</cite>, a.
